procedures.name: Payment-to-voucher reference
procedures.objective: Determine whether every recorded payment references an observed voucher.

procedures.name: Voucher-to-purchase-order reference
procedures.objective: Determine whether every voucher expected to have a PO references an observed PO.

procedures.name: PO → voucher → payment chain coherence
procedures.objective: Test whether the supplied AP document chain closes and amounts/dates cohere.
procedures.limitations: Document-chain coherence does not authenticate any document.

procedures.name: Payment segregation of duties
procedures.objective: Evaluate observed separation between payment creation and approval.
procedures.limitations: Field semantics and compensating controls require auditor evaluation.

procedures.name: Vendor relational-twin screening
procedures.objective: Identify vendors with unusually similar observed identities or relationships.
procedures.limitations: A structural twin is an investigation lead, not proof of duplication or fraud.

procedures.name: Payment-to-bank clearing
procedures.objective: Determine whether recorded payments clear through independent bank evidence.

procedures.name: Payment-to-general-ledger posting
procedures.objective: Determine whether payments post to the GL at the expected amount and period.

procedures.name: AP subledger-to-GL control-account tie
procedures.objective: Reconcile the period-end AP subledger balance to the GL control account.
procedures.evidence_source: period-end AP reconciliation and GL control balance

procedures.name: PO/invoice/goods-receipt three-way match
procedures.objective: Determine whether invoiced and paid goods were ordered and received.

procedures.name: Split-payment review
procedures.objective: Identify payments clustered below an approved authorization threshold.
procedures.limitations: A cluster is advisory and requires business-purpose review.

procedures.name: Closed-population value-flow review
procedures.objective: Screen complete directed value flows for coherent round trips.
procedures.evidence_source: complete counterparty-to-company inflow and outflow feed
procedures.limitations: A coherent cycle is a lead, not an allegation of fraud.
